## Pull request checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and the description explains the change.
- [ ] Relevant tests or documentation checks were run.
- [ ] No secrets, generated noise, or unrelated changes are included.
- [ ] Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [docs/OPEN_PROBLEMS.md](../docs/OPEN_PROBLEMS.md) when the change touches claims or evidence.

## Tip-cite and readiness

- [ ] Tip-cite: `T-Py-T/Highlander <8-char-main-tip> PR#<number> — <short description>`.
- [ ] The tip-cite resolves against `main` and identifies this pull request after merge.
- [ ] A tip-cite records provenance only; it is not a score and does not make this pull request `READY`.
- [ ] Do not invent scores or claim or imply `READY`; blocked, untested, or unresolved work is never `READY`, and only the Steward can resolve readiness.

## Honesty footer

This template reports contribution boundaries only; it does not establish completion, production readiness, a universal winner, or a score. See the open [wayfinder #68](https://github.com/T-Py-T/Highlander/issues/68) for stewardship next steps; open problems remain open until the applicable checks, approvals, and retained evidence exist.
